name: Nekomata ~Futanari Hen~
source:
Main character is a usual student who lives poorly since parents often vanish and go somewhere. One day he discovers two abandoned kittens and takes them home. Soon he gets hit by the truck. When he awakens, he sees a fantasy animal store owner Lyme who was able to save him, but the cost for that was turning two kittens into girls. From this day strange cohabitation begins.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-october-2008-volume-7.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名普通学生，因双亲动辄离家不知去向而过着拮据清贫的日子。某天他在路边捡到了两只遭人遗弃的小猫并带回家收养，不料没过多久便遭遇车祸被卡车撞倒。等他苏醒过来时，守在身旁的是一位名叫莱姆的奇幻宠物店店主——对方虽然救回了他的性命，代价却是将他捡回的两只小猫双双变成了猫耳少女。一段奇妙的同居生活自此拉开帷幕。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-october-2008-volume-7.html]vndbreview[/url]]
